articles.title: The World’s Copper Squeeze Is Set to Intensify on AI and Defense Spending, S&P Says
articles.mainIdea: The World’s Copper Squeeze Is Set to Intensify on AI and Defense Spending, S&P Says
articles.summary: Bloomberg: The World’s Copper Squeeze Is Set to Intensify on AI and Defense Spending, S&P Says. Demand growth is accelerating just as mine supply faces structural limits, raising the risk that copper becomes a bottleneck for economic growth and technological expansion, S&P Global wrote Thursday in a report backed by the mining industry. “What this study shows is that the world is tracking toward a supply deficit even before you consider these new growth vectors.” Related tickers mentioned: BHP, GOOG, HG=F.
